title: Yeasty Creamy Kenyan Trout Gratin
description: A yeasty and creamy Kenyan dish featuring trout, shio-cure, and dairy-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This indulgent gratin is sure to impress your guests.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-cure, yeast extract, and non-dairy milk.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the trout fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the trout to a baking dish and pour the shio-cure mixture over the top.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast over the top, if using.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the trout is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
